subject: FalconRidge SIG/Control mapping — follow-up and evidence plan
messages:
From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@falconridge.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@falconridge.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FalconRidge SIG: control mapping & evidence schedule

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. FalconRidge is starting its formal SIG intake and we need a couple of clarifications so we can map controls and schedule artifact collection. Specifically: 

- Can you confirm which SIG v10 controls Redwood maps to our in-house encryption, KMS, key rotation, and backup controls? We need the specific control IDs your team maps to so our risk team can crosswalk.
- For SOC 2: could you provide a short summary (1–2 pages) of your 2026 SOC 2 scope, auditors, and the set of controls tested? We do not need the full report yet, just the scope summary and date range.
- Evidence: for encryption at rest and key management we typically request: KMS policy, rotation proof (audit logs or config), architecture diagram showing KMS boundary, and a sample encrypted object metadata. Please indicate which of these you can provide and an expected delivery date.

Our procurement target is to complete the SIG/Q&A pass and evidence review by 10 June; would Redwood be able to stick to that timeline if we received the initial mapping this week?

If helpful, we can set a short alignment call tomorrow morning.

Best,
Michael Tan
CISO (acting)
FalconRidge Financial

Attachments: none
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@falconridge.com>
Cc: aditi.m@falconridge.com, procure@falconridge.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FalconRidge SIG: control mapping & evidence schedule

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list. Yes, we can take this on. Quick answers up front:

- SIG mapping: we'll deliver a control crosswalk (SIG v10 => Redwood control IDs) in the template attached. That will include the specific control IDs you asked for (encryption, KMS, backup, rotation).
- SOC 2: I attached a SOC 2 scope snapshot (SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf) that lists auditor, date range, and scope. It is a 1-page executive summary suitable for procurement and risk teams.
- Evidence: we can provide KMS policy, rotation logs (redacted), an architecture diagram showing KMS boundaries, and a sample encrypted object header (redacted). See the attachments list below.

Proposed delivery timeline:
- Today (within 24 hours): SIG-control-mapping-template.xlsx (filled with high-level mappings) + SOC 2 scope snapshot
- By Tue, 25 May: KMS policy + rotation audit log excerpts + kms-dataflow-diagram.png
- By Fri, 28 May: sample encrypted object metadata + any additional minor artifacts

If that works, I'll loop in our security lead, Kimberly Park, and our contract lead, Jordan Blake, for any contract/processor addendum questions. We can also set a 30-minute call tomorrow at 9am PT to walk through the mapping. Let me know if you prefer a different slot.

Thanks — attaching the mapping template now.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: SIG-control-mapping-template.xlsx, SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: FalconRidge SIG: control mapping & evidence schedule

Internal — forwarding FalconRidge request. Action items: 

On the timeline above (deliver first wave today/tomorrow):
- Kimberly: can you prepare the KMS policy export (redacted), a short note on key rotation cadence, and two sample rotation audit log excerpts showing rotation events from 2026? They want rotation proof and a diagram showing where KMS sits relative to tenant data. Please also export the kms-dataflow-diagram.png from our architecture repo and redact any internal hostnames. Target: EOD Monday (25 May) for policy + logs + diagram.
- Jordan: procurement is asking about the processor addendum and whether Redwood will accept a mutual DPA change to log retention limits. Can you draft a short note on our standard DPA stance and any negotiable items (retention, breach notification SLA) so I can include it in the response? Target: Tue, 25 May COB.

I'll attach the mapping template and the SOC 2 scope snapshot in the external reply.

Thanks — Camila
